title: In 2024, the number of days with moderate or higher air pollution was nearly twice as high at rural sites (11.0 days) compared with urban sites (6.2 days)
sourcetext: Air Quality Statistics from the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
commstext: In the UK in 2024, the average number of days when air pollution was moderate or higher was 6.2 at urban sites and 11.0 at rural sites. This represents a short-term improvement for both urban and rural sites compared with 2019 (12.1 days at urban sites and 18.8 days at rural sites). In the long-term, urban sites have seen a positive change, decreasing from 15.6 days in 2010 to 6.2 days in 2024. Rural sites have seen a long-term negative change, increasing from 9.8 days in 2010 to higher levels in the late 2010s, but declining to 11.0 days in 2024, which remains above 2010 levels.
